main_visual_task: Cold milk meets the brewed espresso and becomes the hero cup - crown, nebula, reveal and a held hero composition, four motivated internal shots with no people.

user_script_review.note: 方向1「一粒豆子的日出」8镜两段分镜表获用户选定（飞书）

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same unlabeled pour-over set plus one white ceramic cup filled with dark espresso and cold cream milk; no branding anywhere
prompt_bible.environment_lock: sunlit wooden cafe table beside a rain-fresh window, soft blue morning city light outside, no people inside or outside
prompt_bible.material_lock: real crema marbling, cream threads, glass and ceramic surfaces, physically plausible splashes and steam ribbons
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: hard warm sunrise key from upper left with a fixed cool blue fill from the window
prompt_bible.palette_lock: deep espresso brown, cream white, morning gold, cool window blue
prompt_bible.lens_texture: photoreal commercial tabletop cinematography, macro depth of field, crisp steam silhouettes, controlled high-speed impact
prompt_bible.screen_direction: energy travels left-to-right across cuts; the cup ends centered; label areas remain blank
prompt_bible.audio_policy: four diegetic rhythmic accents: milk drop splash, soft swirl, settling cup, final steam hiss; no voice

internal_shots.visual_state: one cold milk drop strikes the dark espresso surface inside the white ceramic cup
internal_shots.subject_action: the impact crowns into a ring that collapses into spreading cream ripples
internal_shots.camera_action: locked high-speed macro camera; the impact supplies the motion
internal_shots.focus: crown edge and the first cream rings
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key backlights the crown while cool fill holds the crema
internal_shots.end_state: cream rings widen toward the cup rim

camera_plan.motivation: restart the energy at the smallest scale with a tactile impact
camera_plan.start_position: extreme macro level with the espresso surface
camera_plan.path: camera remains locked on the impact point
camera_plan.focus_transition: crown peak to spreading cream rings
camera_plan.axis_lock: ripples expand radially with no lateral drift
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut exactly when the rings touch the rim

internal_shots.visual_state: cream threads swirl into a golden-brown nebula across the espresso surface
internal_shots.subject_action: marble patterns merge and slow into one soft galaxy
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow push-in toward the swirl center
internal_shots.focus: leading cream thread and the galaxy core
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key warps into liquid caustics inside the swirl
internal_shots.end_state: the swirl settles near-still with one last thread

camera_plan.motivation: make the cup a small universe worth entering
camera_plan.start_position: macro level just above the cup rim
camera_plan.path: push straight down toward the swirl core
camera_plan.speed_curve: slow constant push with gentle ease-out
camera_plan.focus_transition: outer cream threads to galaxy core
camera_plan.end_position: extreme macro on the settled swirl core
camera_plan.axis_lock: push vertically only while the swirl rotates clockwise
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the core turns near-still

internal_shots.visual_state: the camera leaves the swirl and reveals the white cup on the wooden table with steam ribbons rising
internal_shots.subject_action: steam ribbons climb through a shaft of sunrise while beans and the amber carafe sit quiet
internal_shots.camera_action: one smooth pull back from the cup rim to the full table scene
internal_shots.focus: cup silhouette then the whole tabletop
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key now reads as full morning across the table
internal_shots.end_state: table scene composes - cup left-of-center, carafe right, window glow behind

camera_plan.motivation: give the transformed liquid its real-world home
camera_plan.start_position: extreme macro on the settled swirl
camera_plan.path: pull straight back and slightly up to tabletop level
camera_plan.speed_curve: smooth medium pull with steady ease
camera_plan.focus_transition: swirl core to cup silhouette to full tabletop
camera_plan.axis_lock: cup remains left-of-center while the pull stays on its axis
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the full setting reads in one glance

internal_shots.visual_state: final hero - the white cup with marbled crema centered, carafe and beans flanking, steam curling upward
internal_shots.subject_action: one last steam ribbon rises and dissolves while the crema marbling holds
internal_shots.camera_action: locked hero framing that stays perfectly still through the final hold
internal_shots.focus: crema marbling and the steam silhouette
internal_shots.lighting_state: balanced sunrise key and cool fill with a gentle highlight bloom
internal_shots.end_state: a clean brand-ready hero frame with steam still curling

camera_plan.motivation: resolve the journey into a single readable product image
camera_plan.start_position: medium wide centered on the cup
camera_plan.path: camera locked in place while only the steam moves
camera_plan.focus_transition: crema marbling to the rising steam
camera_plan.axis_lock: cup stays centered and vertical with nothing drifting
camera_plan.stop_condition: hold the still frame for the final one and a half seconds

first_frame: extreme macro of one milk drop crowning on dark espresso
last_frame: held hero frame of the marbled coffee cup with steam curling, carafe and beans flanking
